verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor ships an official MCP Server with 40+ specialised tools that plugs into Claude Desktop, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. The editor's agent tooling can create particle emitters, reorganise scenes into layers and rename objects, and the Game Agent MCP lets a coding agent build and tweak games (e.g. making gravity stronger) by calling tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of programmatically triggering builds or publishes, a published per-tool reference for the MCP tools, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
